<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/emails/test"}
#docs
Recorded in the email log with a `[Test]` subject prefix and no customer attached.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | `string` | **yes** | The address to send the test email to. |
| `type` | `string` | **yes** | The email type to send a test of. One of `invoice_issued`, `payment_receipt`, `payment_failed`, `subscription_canceled_nonpayment`. |
| `draft` | `object` | no | Send this unsaved draft instead of the stored template. |
| `draft.subject` | `string` | **yes** | The draft subject line. |
| `draft.heading` | `string` | **yes** | The draft heading. |
| `draft.body` | `string` | **yes** | The draft body text. |
| `draft.footer` | `string` | no | This email's own footer, same syntax and HTML subset as body. Null or empty uses the business footer (`email_config.footerNote`), else the built-in one. |
| `draft.cta_label` | `string` | no | Button text; only for emails with a button. Null keeps the default. |
| `draft.show_facts` | `boolean` | no | Whether the email shows the table of key facts (such as amount and date). |
| `draft.block_order` | `array of string` | no | Order of the movable sections, each exactly once. Null = body, action, facts, footer. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `email_test`. One of `email_test`. |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True if the email was sent. |
| `error` | `string` | Why sending failed, when it did. |
| `transport` | `string` | How the email was sent. One of `console`, `smtp`, `esp`. |
| `email_id` | `string` | The id of the email message that was created. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Test performed |
| `400` | Invalid request |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/emails/test" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "to": "maya@example.com",
    "type": "invoice_issued"
  }'
```
